instruction: A candid, documentary-style full-length photograph captures a couple walking down outdoor marble steps. The man in the white button-up shirt (R2) is on the left, wearing beige trousers and light sneakers, smiling as he steps down. Beside him on the right, the woman in the white one-shoulder dress (R1) walks down in beige strappy heels, holding a small bouquet in her outer hand. They walk hand-in-hand, their inner hands clasped together. The scene is illuminated by soft, natural daylight, creating a warm, bright atmosphere with gentle shadows on the stone steps.
